name: motet-enrich-toolchain
description: The agent toolchain the motet-enrich image installs: pi, the MCP adapter, and a stealth Playwright MCP server.
//: Exact versions, no ranges. This is third-party code that drives a browser over untrusted pages inside a container; a caret here would mean the image's contents change without a commit. package-lock.json pins the whole tree, and `npm ci` is what the Dockerfile runs. Bumping any of these is a PR, and the one to read the changelog for is pi-mcp-adapter, which resolves two of its own dependencies from pkg.pr.new rather than from the registry.
